review.review_method: conservative rectangles annotated on the frozen canonical pixel mapping while preserving source labels
review.uncertainty: Rectangle bounds are annotations, not measured geometry; no statistical uncertainty was supplied. Labels derive from a community overview and do not establish plant boundaries, full zone extents, or walkability.

source.description: Community tactical overview; verification input only and not redistributed.

canonical_mapping.coordinate_convention: canonical image pixels; rectangle x0,y0 inclusive and x1,y1 exclusive

rejected_annotations.label: A Main
rejected_annotations.rejection_reason: The exact reviewed rectangle midpoint has canonical alpha 0 and is outside the canonical alpha interior; retained only as rejected review evidence, not an accepted annotation.

use_restrictions: Annotations are provisional interior samples only, not zone outlines or geometry.
Do not infer plant boundaries, complete walkable masks, polygon extents, or broadcast orientation.
Keep annotations separate from production map geometry until full VTA-102 acceptance.

acceptance.remaining: independently reviewed true site and spawn extents, walkable geometry, and named-zone polygons with evidence and held-out validation
